recipes.title: Ferris wheel
notes: The wheel stands upright on its axle between two A-frames and turns.

recipes.title: Balsa glider
notes: Glue only; thin balsa splits on screws.
Sand the wing's leading edge round for lift.

recipes.title: Toy airplane
notes: The propeller spins on a dowel shaft; the wheels turn on a through axle.

recipes.title: Reindeer
notes: Antlers branch from the head; screw each joint with two 2½″ screws.

recipes.title: Marble run
notes: Tilt each ramp about 5° down toward its drop; the marble zig-zags to the catch tray.

recipes.title: Kids tipi
notes: A kid-size play tipi: lash the poles at the top and drape the fabric cover, with a door gap at the front.

recipes.title: Treasure chest
notes: A craft-size chest; the lid swings up on a hinge at the back.

recipes.title: Compost bin
notes: Open slatted bays share their posts; no floor or roof so the pile drains and breathes.
Front slats lift out to turn the pile.
Set the posts in the ground 12″ deep.

recipes.title: Deck stairs
notes: Cut the stringers to a sawtooth: 7½″ rise and 10½″ run per step; set the stringer feet on pier blocks and bolt the top to the deck rim.

recipes.title: Pergola
notes: 4×4 posts set in concrete footings, doubled beams, rafters on top.

recipes.title: Taj Mahal
notes: Onion dome on a drum over the square hall, four arched iwans and four corner minarets on the plinth.

recipes.title: Colosseum
notes: An elliptical ring of piers with three tiers of arcades around an open arena.

recipes.title: Murphy bed
notes: The queen bed frame pivots down out of the wall cabinet on its fold brackets; the leg folds out to carry the foot.
Lag the cabinet to two wall studs before the bed is mounted.

recipes.title: Mudroom locker
notes: Tall open locker bays with a bench seat, a top shelf and a coat hook in each; anchor the top to a wall stud.

recipes.title: Floating desk
notes: The top cantilevers off a wall cleat lagged into studs at desk height; no legs.

recipes.title: Under-stairs shelves
notes: Uprights step down with the stair slope; scribe each top to the stringer.

recipes.title: Sandbox
notes: No floor: set it in the ground on a level bed and lay landscape fabric under the sand so it drains.

recipes.title: Water Wheel
notes: Ring wheel cut from exterior plywood on a hub
Axle is a hardwood dowel resting in the posts
Each post stands on its own base

recipes.title: Abacus
notes: Frame cut from 2x4 lumber
Rods are 1/4 in hardwood dowels set in holes drilled through the top and bottom rails
Beads are slices of 1 in dowel, drilled to slide freely on each rod
